items.summary: # Korean Professor Proposes 'Sustainability Robotics' in Nature Journal. A Korean university has become the first in the world to propose "Sustainability Robotics," a new research paradigm that evaluates not only the technical performance of robots but also their environmental, social, and economic value. The Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology (DGIST) said that a manifesto on "Sustainability Robotics" proposed by Song Seok-ho, a professor in the Department of Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering, was selected as the cover paper for the July 2026 issue of Nature Machine Intelligence, a globally authoritative journal in the AI and robotics field. This represents a departure from previous research directions that focused on improving the speed, accuracy, and performance of robots. 7. **keywords**: Trích từ khóa từ văn bản người dùng cung cấp.
8. **send**: Gửi một đoạn văn bản đi.
9. **policy**: Tìm trong tài liệu nội bộ.
10. **papers**: Tìm bài báo khoa học.
11. **paper_text**: Lấy nội dung text của một bài báo.
